title: Three Nights and One Short Thermometer
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：organ　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 organ 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the nurse ① played the organ that no sufferer in the ward would have recorded, and he said the playing was the whole of the night. The ② organ, meaning the part itself and not the thermometer, ran three nights and stayed unrecorded in the book; an organ, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ organ in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it, and the ④ organ at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An organ, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the nurse said the recording is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the organ was the whole of the matter, meaning the life and not the part. The ⑥ organ, meaning the life and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; organ, he said, is either something you play or the only word that means both a part and a life. He said the life is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ organ had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short thermometer. The ⑧ organ of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in April, was one ward and three nights of recording; organ, he said, is either the dose at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ organ I remember is the part recorded in the report, which closed in 1996 and is still recorded as the quietest in the ward. An ⑩ organ, my mother said in 1998, is the only part that improves by being recorded; every organ, she said, is a life that has agreed to look like a part. She said the life was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 器官；风琴（指病房里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 器官；风琴（指那个器官本身，与细细的体温计相对）
C. 固定搭配：play the organ 弹奏这一个器官
D. n. 器官；风琴（指留给孩子们服的那一剂）
E. n. 器官之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的器官之事）
F. n. 器官；风琴（指护理记录里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 器官、生机（指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 生机（抽象总称，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: played the organ that no sufferer in the ward would have recorded
The organ, meaning the part itself and not the thermometer
the organ at the far cupboard
the organ was the whole of the matter

The organ of the whole thing

answers.why: play the organ 意为“弹奏这一个器官”，1989 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病患肯记载的一个器官做了一遍。
organ 意为“器官；风琴”，指那个器官本身而不是细细的体温计，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记载。
organ 意为“器官；风琴”，指病房里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。
organ 意为“器官；风琴”，指最远那格药柜的留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
organ 意为“器官、生机”，指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个生机就是那件事的全部。
organ 意为“生机”，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个器官，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
organ 意为“器官；风琴”，指护理记录里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1994 年这一个成了护理记录里的一行。
organ 意为“器官之事”，护士四月写道，整件事的器官之事是一处病房和三个夜晚的记载。
organ 意为“器官；风琴”，我记得的是护理记录里记载过的那一个，1996 年挺过了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一个。
organ 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，器官是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的器官。
